Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production RTS worker sprite action sheet, exactly FOUR equal columns and SIX equal rows (24 independently drawn animation frames), portrait canvas, genuinely transparent alpha. Input image is an identity/style reference only: faithfully match this same civilian worker's brown soft hat, dark beard, rolled cream linen sleeves, ochre leather apron with shoulder straps, teal waist sash, brown trousers, stout brown boots, belt pouches, and tool-holding hand. Warm handpainted frontier game art, roughly four-head proportions, readable natural shapes, warm upper-left illumination, no armor, swords, shield, modern gear, text, numbers, borders, scenery, grid lines or baked ground/shadow. Every frame is full body, exactly the same camera scale, identity and proportions; character feet centered on the same ground baseline in each invisible cell, tools fully inside the cell with generous transparent gutters. ROW 1 idle: four subtle but visibly different breathing/weight-settle poses, tool lowered. ROW 2 WALK: genuine left-contact, passing, right-contact, passing leg cycle, alternating bent knees and planted/raised boots with arm counter-swing; NOT copies or shifted versions of one pose. ROW 3 HARVEST: four axe-working poses, overhead windup, strong downward swing, low impact with bent knees, recovery; no target or scenery. ROW 4 HURT: recoil, brace on bent knees, regain balance, recover; no gore. ROW 5 DEATH: stagger, kneel, fall, lie still on the same ground line, tool down; same physical scale throughout. ROW 6 BUILD: four carpenter mallet poses, raise, strike, bend/impact, recover; axe holstered, mallet in the same anatomical tool hand. Perspective direction must be genuinely reconstructed for every frame. Never create a left-facing sheet by mirroring a right-facing sheet. Keep hands, sash knot, pouches and face consistent with the reference.
DIRECTION E: strict right-facing side profile, face and toes toward screen RIGHT, camera sees the worker's side. One consistent side-profile perspective for all 24 frames.

processing.creativeEdits: No animation synthesized from mirrored or translated copies of one pose. Normalization only applies alpha cleanup, component extraction, one shared scale per sheet, and cell anchoring to the independently authored frames.

validation.directionVisualReview: E/W strict profile; NE/NW rear three-quarter; SE/SW front three-quarter. E first draft rejected for three-quarter view; SW idle row corrected because it originally faced right.
validation.movementPoseReview: Walk frames use alternating legs/knees/boots; work/build rows use axe/mallet body bends; death remains a shorter horizontal body at the shared scale.
validation.limitation: Single-perspective action row poses may yaw slightly during work/fall. This does not claim a rigid3D skeleton or per-resource unique tool sheet.
